name: saas-kanban-board
context: Design a project management Kanban board interface for teams tracking work items across workflow stages. The audience is project managers and developers who need drag-and-drop task organization, status visibility, and quick task creation. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and tablet.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json scale ratio for card titles and metadata
Apply color.rules.json semantic roles for column status indicators
Use layout.rules.json grid system for column distribution
Drag-and-drop interactions must provide ARIA live region announcements
All interactive elements must meet WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard operability
Column containers must use proper list semantics (role=list, role=listitem)

outputCriteria.format: Component composition spec with token references, drag interaction states, and responsive layout
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens from Token_System
Column headers use defined heading scale from typography.rules.json
Card components document all interaction states including drag
Layout adapts from multi-column to stacked on smaller viewports
No raw/hardcoded visual values present in output
accessibilityRequirements: Drag-and-drop has keyboard alternative (select + move commands)
ARIA live regions announce card movement between columns
Focus management returns to logical position after card move
All text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio against card background
Column count and card count announced to screen readers

examples.description: Kanban column with task cards using token-based styling
examples.output:
Organism: KanbanColumn
  Layout: flex(direction: column, gap: var(--space-sm))
  bg: var(--color-surface-secondary)
  radius: var(--radius-md)
  padding: var(--space-md)
  Children:
    - Molecule: ColumnHeader
        Content:
          - Atom: Text(role=heading, token=typography.heading.sm, color=color.text.primary)
          - Atom: Badge(count, variant=neutral)
    - Molecule: TaskCard (role=listitem, draggable=true)
        bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
        border: var(--border-default)
        radius: var(--radius-md)
        padding: var(--space-md)
        States: default, hover(shadow: var(--shadow-sm)), dragging(opacity: 0.6, shadow: var(--shadow-lg)), drop-target(border-color: var(--color-primary))
